release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.7.7 Security & Precision Polish Update:
• Hardware-Backed Cryptographic Encryption: Sensitive credentials including SMTP passwords and tokens are now encrypted using Android KeyStore AES-256-GCM authenticated cipher.
• Salted PBKDF2 PIN Protection: Parental authentication PINs are hashed using salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (10,000 rounds) with per-device cryptographic salts, guarding against rainbow table brute-force attacks.
• Tactile Keypad Refinement: Completely eliminated horizontal reflection line cuts across keypad buttons and the guardian security medallion. Digits are smoothly contoured with continuous radial gradients.
• High-Definition Vector Backspace: Replaced unrendered font glyph with native vector backspace rendering across all Android device versions.
• Background Zero-Touch OTA Auto-Update: FocusForegroundService checks for releases silently in the background with one-tap notification updater.
